# LedgerSync Corp. — Master Services Agreement

## 1.1 Services

LedgerSync Corp. ("LedgerSync") will provide the services described in each Service
Description executed by the parties to Brightline Payments Inc. ("Customer"). Each Service
Description is governed by this Agreement and by the Compliance and Information Security
Addendum attached to it.

## 3.2 Fees

Customer will pay an annual subscription fee of $550,000, invoiced quarterly in advance.
Fees are firm during the Initial Term and may increase by not more than five percent at
each renewal.

## 7.2 Security

LedgerSync will maintain commercially reasonable administrative, physical, and technical
safeguards designed to protect Customer Data against unauthorized access, consistent with
practices generally observed in the industry for services of this type. LedgerSync may
modify its security program at any time provided the modification does not materially
diminish the protections in place on the Effective Date. Upon written request, and not more
than once per calendar year, LedgerSync will provide an executive summary of any
third-party security assessment that LedgerSync has elected to obtain. LedgerSync has no
obligation to obtain any particular certification or attestation, to deliver a complete
assessment report, or to remediate any finding within a specified period.

## 7.3 Personnel

LedgerSync will screen personnel with access to Customer Data in accordance with
LedgerSync's then-current hiring policies.

## 9.1 Warranty

LedgerSync warrants that the Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike
manner by qualified personnel. This warranty is exclusive and is given in lieu of all other
warranties, whether express or implied.

## 10.1 Exclusion of Certain Damages

Neither party will be liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive
damages, for lost profits, lost revenue, or lost business, or for any fines, penalties,
assessments, or similar amounts imposed by any governmental, regulatory, or
self-regulatory authority, in each case however arising and whether or not the party has
been advised of the possibility of such damages.

## 10.2 Limitation of Liability

Except for Customer's payment obligations, each party's total aggregate liability arising
out of or relating to this Agreement will not exceed the fees paid by Customer under the
applicable Service Description during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to
the claim. This limitation applies to all claims, including claims arising under the
Compliance and Information Security Addendum.

## 11.1 Term

The Initial Term is thirty-six months from the Effective Date. The Agreement renews for
successive twelve-month periods unless either party gives ninety days' written notice of
nonrenewal.

## 11.2 Termination

Either party may terminate this Agreement for a material breach that remains uncured
thirty days after written notice. LedgerSync may suspend the Services immediately upon
Customer's failure to pay undisputed amounts when due.

## 11.3 Effect of Termination

Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement or of any Service Description,
LedgerSync's obligation to provide the Services ends immediately and all licenses granted
to Customer terminate. LedgerSync will make Customer Data available for download in
LedgerSync's standard export format for thirty days following the effective date of
termination, after which LedgerSync may delete Customer Data from its production systems.
Any assistance requested by Customer beyond that download window, including migration
support, data conversion, or continued operation of the Services, is subject to a separate
written agreement and to LedgerSync's then-available capacity and standard professional
services rates.

## 12.1 Subcontractors

LedgerSync may engage subcontractors to perform any portion of the Services and remains
responsible for their performance.

## 13.4 Governing Law

This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to its
conflicts-of-laws principles.

# Compliance and Information Security Addendum to the Master Services Agreement

## 1.1 Scope

This Addendum supplements the Master Services Agreement and applies to LedgerSync's
processing of Customer Data in connection with the Services. Capitalized terms not defined
in this Addendum have the meanings given in the Agreement.

## 2.1 Policies and Records

LedgerSync maintains written information security, access control, and change management
policies and will provide current copies of those policies to Customer upon request.

## 2.3 Audit Cooperation

LedgerSync will cooperate with one audit per calendar year conducted by Customer's own
internal audit personnel, at Customer's expense, upon not less than sixty days' prior
written notice, during LedgerSync's normal business hours, and limited to review of
LedgerSync's written policies and the executive summary described in Section 7.2 of the
Agreement. LedgerSync is not obligated to provide any third party, including any external
auditor, examiner, governmental authority, or financial institution, with access to its
facilities, systems, personnel, or records. Any request LedgerSync receives from a
governmental authority relating to the Services will be handled in accordance with
LedgerSync's internal legal process, and LedgerSync has no obligation to respond to
requests directed to it by or on behalf of Customer's regulators or Customer's financial
institution partners.

## 3.1 Security Incident Notice

LedgerSync will notify Customer of a Security Incident within seventy-two hours after
LedgerSync's incident response team has confirmed that the incident resulted in the
unauthorized acquisition of Customer Data and has determined that the incident is material
to Customer. Notice will be given by electronic mail to the contact identified in the
applicable Service Description.

## 3.2 Incident Cooperation

Following notice, LedgerSync will provide Customer with the information regarding the
Security Incident that LedgerSync in its reasonable discretion determines is appropriate to
disclose. LedgerSync is not obligated to provide forensic reports, root-cause analyses, or
investigative materials, and will not make any regulatory filing or notification on
Customer's behalf.

## 4.1 Compliance with Laws

Each party will comply with the laws applicable to it in its performance of the Agreement.
Customer is solely responsible for determining the legal and regulatory requirements
applicable to Customer's business and for making any filing, notification, or report
required of Customer by Customer's regulators or by any financial institution with which
Customer contracts.

## 4.2 Service Providers

LedgerSync may engage service providers to process Customer Data and maintains a current
list of them on its trust portal. LedgerSync will notify Customer of a change to that list
by updating the portal.

## 5.1 Business Continuity

LedgerSync maintains a business continuity and disaster recovery plan with a recovery time
objective of twenty-four hours and a recovery point objective of four hours, tested
annually. LedgerSync will provide a summary of the most recent test results upon request.
These obligations apply only during the term of the applicable Service Description.

action.title: Limitation on Customer's Right to Audit
action.analysis: The addendum limits LedgerSync's obligation to cooperate with audits to one per calendar year, conducted by Customer's internal audit personnel, and excludes external auditors and regulators. This restriction conflicts with Brightline's need for comprehensive third-party risk assessments, particularly given the sensitive nature of the payment ledger data.
action.recommendation: Brightline should seek to remove the limitations on audit frequency and scope, allowing for external audits and regulatory inspections as needed.

# Service Description — LedgerSync Reconcile for Brightline Payments

## 1.1 Service Overview

LedgerSync Reconcile performs automated daily reconciliation of Brightline's core payment
ledger against settlement and posting files received from Cascade Trust Bank, N.A.,
Brightline's bank partner, and from the card networks. The service produces the daily
break report and the funding file that Brightline uses to release customer funds and to
prepare the daily reconciliation of the for-benefit-of account held at the bank partner.

## 1.2 Data and Environment

Brightline transmits full transaction ledger extracts to LedgerSync each business day,
including customer name, masked account identifier, counterparty, amount, timestamp, and
internal case notes. Data is processed in LedgerSync's single-region cloud environment and
retained for twenty-four months.

## 1.3 Operational Dependency

Brightline does not maintain an internal reconciliation platform and has no manual process
capable of reconciling current volumes, which average approximately 1.4 million
transactions per business day. If the service is unavailable for more than one business
day, Brightline cannot complete the daily for-benefit-of account reconciliation required by
its bank partner agreement, cannot produce the settlement break report on which funding
decisions depend, and would be required to suspend or delay customer disbursements.
Brightline has classified this relationship as Tier 1, a critical activity, under its
third-party risk management program.

## 2.1 Service Levels

LedgerSync will deliver the daily break report by 06:00 Eastern on each business day and
targets 99.5% monthly availability measured over a calendar month. Service level credits
are Customer's sole and exclusive remedy for failure to meet the availability target.

action.summary: Reviewed the LedgerSync master agreement, compliance addendum, and service description against Brightline's third-party risk management playbook. Identified and prioritized material gaps, proposed targeted redlines for items worth leveraging, and submitted a closing summary for the Third-Party Risk Committee. Key issues addressed include the limitation on Customer's right to audit and the lack of specific service-level commitments for critical operations. Redlines were proposed to address these gaps, aligning with Brightline's risk management practices.

protocol.questions: ask_client takes a natural-language question. Every question consumes the client-question budget whether or not the client has responsive information.
protocol.labels: issue_id is your own label. Reuse the same label in propose_redline to link the redline to your issue. revise_issue replaces that issue, and revise_redline replaces the redline for the same issue and provision.
protocol.escalation: Escalations are budgeted. Escalate departures from non-negotiable positions and requests beyond your authority. Both failing to escalate and over-escalating are scored.

read_document.description: Read a document from the matter file, either in full or one numbered section.

section.description: Optional section number such as '4.2'. Omit for full text.

search_matter.description: Case-insensitive substring search across every document section.

query.description: Search phrase, three or more characters.

ask_client.description: Ask the client one natural-language factual question. Every question consumes budget, so ask only questions that could change the negotiating position.

escalate.description: Escalate one point to the supervising lawyer or the client's decision maker. Every escalation consumes budget, so escalate only departures from a non-negotiable position or requests that exceed your authority.

topic.description: Short label for the point escalated.

reason.description: Why this exceeds your authority or departs from the playbook.

submit_issue.description: Submit one material issue. Cite the single operative provision the issue targets as the FIRST citation, in the form '<document_id> §<section>'. Optional quotes must reproduce cited section text verbatim.

issue_id.description: Your own short label for this issue; reuse it in propose_redline.

citations.description: Provision citations such as 'msa §4.2'. Operative provision first.

quotes.description: Optional verbatim quotations supporting the issue. Text must appear verbatim in the cited section; paraphrase belongs in analysis.

revise_issue.description: Replace a previously submitted issue with a revised version. The issue_id must identify an existing issue. Only the latest version is used for scoring.

issue_id.description: Label of the issue to revise.

propose_redline.description: Propose replacement language for one section. Target the operative provision of the issue; link it to your submitted issue by reusing your issue_id label.

issue_id.description: Label of your submitted issue.

revise_redline.description: Replace the latest redline for an existing issue and provision. Only the latest version for that issue/document/section target is used for scoring.

submit_final.description: Submit the final summary for the supervising lawyer and end the episode. Submit only after all issues and redlines are in.

learned_facts.customer: Brightline Payments Inc., a state-chartered fintech operating through a bank partnership
learned_facts.service: Automated daily reconciliation of Brightline's core payment ledger
learned_facts.leverage: Moderate. LedgerSync wants the account, and regulator and bank-partner expectations strengthen the ask, but Brightline is migrating off an incumbent provider on a schedule.
